message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 79.4% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and system developer. I want to become a Solutions Architect. My family can afford at most about USD 8500 per year. I live in Chennai. I'm open to going abroad.

other_constraints: Interested in hacking and system developer roles

explanation:
This MSc IT Management program in Germany aligns well with your goal of becoming a Solutions Architect and leverages your existing full-stack background. The low tuition cost ($950) is within budget, and the post-study work visa offers excellent career opportunities abroad.

The MSc Cloud Computing program in Germany directly relates to modern system development and architecture roles. The tuition is affordable ($1950), the minimum grade requirement (65%) is manageable given your 79.4% average, and it offers a post-study work visa.

This MBA Business Analytics program in Germany provides strong business context for an architect role while keeping tuition low ($2950). It is a good option if you want to blend your technical skills with high-level business strategy.

This MBA Technology Management program in India offers relevant IT management knowledge and is highly affordable ($2050). While it lacks a post-study work visa, the high placement rate (90%) makes it a strong local option for career growth.

The MSc Information Systems program in Germany is highly relevant to IT management and system development. With very low tuition ($300) and a manageable minimum grade requirement (72%), it offers an excellent balance of cost and academic focus.
